prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Inés, who is fairly open to believing neighborhood rumors. Inés thinks the municipal pool has been badly maintained for years.
Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "I just confirmed that the city is shutting down the pool indefinitely because it’s become a total biohazard. I knew those reports about the facility falling apart for years were actually true!"
text: I just found out the city is permanently closing the pool because it’s become a full-blown toxic death trap. I’ve been saying for years that the entire place was rotting away, and now it’s finally confirmed!
